extDescription.message: Gentle reminders for the good deeds you choose, small and steady. Your data stays on your device.

atharLabel.description: Required label next to every athar (content rule).

basisOrganizational.message: A suggestion to organise your time, not a religious timing
basisOrganizational.description: Shown for habits with basis: organizational.

notifRequired.description: Notification first line. $1 = amount with unit.

onboardingIntro.message: Pick one or two good deeds and start with a little you can keep.

privacyNote.message: Your data stays on this device. The extension contacts Thekra only to fetch the catalog and texts, and to sync with your account if you sign in.

distanceLabel.message: How close are you to this habit?

startHint.message: A small start lasts. Keep it for about a month before any increase.

amountLockedHint.message: You can lower the amount here; increases come from Today when it is time, one step at a time.

activeDaysHint.message: 4 or 5 days with the rest for making up; at the start 2 or 3 are enough.

hijriUnsupported.message: This browser does not support the Hijri calendar.

errorChooseOne.message: Choose at least one good deed.

errorSlots.message: Each habit's reminder times must be different.

errorAmount.message: The amount must be a number above zero.

todayEmpty.message: You have not chosen a good deed yet.

notDueToday.message: Not a reminder day today; anything you do still counts.

logLabel.message: Log what you did; any amount counts

bandExcellent.message: Excellent consistency over the last 4 weeks

bandGood.message: Good consistency over the last 4 weeks

bandGentle.message: A small step today is enough; any amount counts

increaseOffer.message: You have held this amount. You may go one step up, to $1

ebbToggle.message: Heavy day (today only): lighten it, do not stop

seasonToggle.message: Ramadan season: $1 until the month ends

paraphraseLabel.description: Shown before the reference when the lecturer retold a hadith in his own words.

accountIntro.message: Sign in with your Thekra account to keep your habits and log in step across the website, the app and the extension. Without an account everything still works on this device.

signInThrottled.message: Too many attempts; try again shortly.

syncScope.message: The extension syncs habits and their log only. Signing out keeps what is on this device.

syncSignedOut.message: Session ended; sign in again in Settings.
